UN Security Council Resolution 60 (1948)

Establishment of a subcommittee to consider amendments and revisions to the revised draft resolution contained in document S/1059/Rev.2 on the question of Palestine

Official document (PDF) · Meeting record S/PV.375

60 (1948). Resolution of 29 October 1948 [S/1062] The Security Council

Resolves that a sub-committee be established consisting of the representatives of the United Kingdom, China, France, Belgium and the Ukrainian Soviet Socialist Republic to consider all the amendments and revisions which have been or may be suggested to the second revised draft resolution contained in document S/1059/Rev.2, 39 and in consultation with the Acting Mediator to prepare a revised draft resolution.

Adopted at the 375th meeting.40

39 See Official Records of the Security Council, Third Year, Supplement for October 1948.

40 Adopted without vote.
